explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/18: are there infinitely many practical m with h(m) < (log log m)^{O(1)}? `practicalH` is the maximum over 1 ≤ m ≤ n of the minimum number of distinct divisors summing to m, which is the page's h; including m = n adds only the trivial value 1. The statement is ∃ C > 0, ∃ᶠ m, practical ∧ h(m) < (log log m)^C. Faithful.
